title: pyrola picta var. dentata
intro: Pyrola picta var. dentata, commonly known as wintergreen, is a flowering plant species in the heath family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of wintergreen are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, ease headaches, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of wintergreen include methyl salicylate, salicylic acid, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
